sources.title: SmolVLA - sudoremove
sources.snippet: SmolVLA is a lightweight VLA model released by HuggingFace on June 3, 2025. With 450M parameters, it achieves equal or better performance than models 7-10x larger, trained only on public community data.

sources.title: SmolVLA | Open Source Robotics
sources.snippet: SmolVLA is a compact 450M parameter Vision-Language-Action model from HuggingFace that runs on consumer hardware, trained on open-source LeRobot datasets.

sources.title: SmolVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Affordable and Efficient ...
sources.snippet: SmolVLA builds on the compact SmolVLM vision-language model and adds an efficient action head using flow matching for continuous action prediction. An asynchronous inference architecture separates the compute-heavy perception backbone from lightweight action execution, enabling real-time control even on consumer-grade hardware.
